meta.description: Outage grid for the map. A customer has no power when any device in its chain is tripped. Current damage is the unrepaired reports, treated as today's outages (simulation, not live data).
meta.customerChains: Aligned with customers.json rows: device indices from the customer's transformer up to the substation breaker. Empty = no upstream data.
meta.candidates: Poles that can fail in a simulated storm: the device they trip, a relative failure weight from historical damage on their circuit, and direct repair hours from labor.json.
meta.traceMethod: device = the damaged asset is the device; line-trace = protection zone along primary lines; secondary = transformer feeding the wire; nearest-transformer = low-confidence fallback; untraced = couldn't be matched; none = no customer impact (lights, capacitor banks).

priorityLocations.description: devices.priority = how many priority locations (hospitals, fire and ambulance stations) the device's repair restores. Matched to the nearest customer point within maxMatchMeters.
